mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, b.name AS batch_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_assignment fa WHERE fa.batch_id = p.batch_id AND fa.status != 'REVOKED') AS admitted_count FROM publicity p JOIN selection_batch b ON b.id = p.batch_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO publicity (batch_id, title, content, start_at, end_at, status, published_by, published_at, closed_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{status}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedAt}, #{closedAt})
mapper.select: WHERE p.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE p.batch_id = #{batchId} AND p.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CLOSED') ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE p.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY p.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE publicity SET status = #{status}, published_by = IFNULL(#{publishedBy}, published_by), published_at = IFNULL(#{publishedAt}, published_at), closed_at = IFNULL(#{closedAt}, closed_at) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM publicity WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
